resumen: The bar rests on the traps and the body goes down until the thighs are parallel to the floor. It works quads and glutes while the torso holds the load.
ejecucion: Rest the bar on your traps, never on your neck, and grip it slightly wider than your shoulders.
Set your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Send the hips back and bend hips and knees together, knees tracking over the feet.
Go down until the thighs are parallel to the floor, keeping the bar over the mid-foot.
Stand up by driving the floor away, without letting the hips rise ahead of the chest.
